title: Learning uncertainty fields for joint brain stroke diagnosis and intrinsic lesion localization in CT and MRI
zh_title: 模糊不确定性场联合脑卒中诊断与病灶定位
summary: DFE-Net 以可学习模糊隶属场表征空间不确定性，在多中心 CT 与 MRI 队列上联合分类卒中并定位病灶。
key_points: 多中心CT队列6650例、8873幅图像
CT AUC 0.974、F1 0.897；MRI AUC 0.978
CT病灶定位对照专家标注Dice 0.70
reason: 多中心大样本影像队列并有独立MRI队列验证，属重要档；回顾性且未报临床结局
abstract: Early stroke changes can be difficult to detect and localize on neuroimaging, particularly when lesion boundaries are indistinct. We developed the Dynamic Fuzzy Encoder Network (DFE-Net), which uses learnable fuzzy membership fields to represent spatial uncertainty and jointly classify stroke and localize lesions. We evaluated the model on a multicentre computed tomography (CT) cohort comprising 6650 patients and 8873 images and a separate magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) cohort comprising 67 patients and 615 images. Training and testing were performed separately within each modality. DFE-Net achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.974 and an F1 score of 0.897 on CT, and corresponding values of 0.978 and 0.879 on MRI. In the CT cohort, lesion localization against expert annotations yielded a Dice score of 0.70. MRI localization was assessed using gradient-derived pseudo-targets because expert lesion masks were unavailable. Expected calibration error was ~0.022 in both cohorts, and the model contained 0.20 million parameters. These results support joint diagnosis and spatial localization with a compact model, while prospective validation and expert-annotated MRI evaluation remain necessary.
zh_abstract: 早期卒中改变在神经影像上可能难以检测和定位，尤其是当病灶边界不清晰时。我们开发了动态模糊编码器网络（Dynamic Fuzzy Encoder Network，DFE-Net），其使用可学习的模糊隶属度场来表示空间不确定性，并联合进行卒中分类和病灶定位。我们在一个包含6650例患者和8873幅图像的多中心计算机断层扫描（computed tomography，CT）队列，以及一个包含67例患者和615幅图像的独立磁共振成像（magnetic resonance imaging，MRI）队列上评估了该模型。训练和测试均在每种模态内分别进行。DFE-Net在CT上达到受试者工作特征曲线下面积0.974和F1分数0.897，在MRI上相应值为0.978和0.879。在CT队列中，与专家标注相比，病灶定位的Dice分数为0.70。由于没有专家病灶掩膜，MRI定位使用梯度衍生的伪目标进行评估。两个队列中的期望校准误差均约为0.022，模型包含20万个参数。这些结果支持使用紧凑模型进行联合诊断和空间定位，但仍需前瞻性验证和专家标注的MRI评估。

title: Challenges for human oversight in detecting system malfunctions in AI-assisted medical diagnostics
zh_title: AI诊断故障时的人类监督挑战
summary: 随机对照研究让48名医生使用可靠性逐步下降的心脏听诊AI，发现医生诊断表现随AI可靠性同步下降，即使被强制先独立判断。
key_points: 48名医生随机对照，AI可靠性递减
医生诊断准确率随AI故障而下降
医生信心下降快于对AI的信任下降
reason: 随机对照人机协作研究、议题重要，但样本仅48名医生，属值得看档
abstract: Increasingly, physicians must oversee AI systems to detect system malfunctions. We studied 48 physicians in a randomized controlled study using an increasingly malfunctioning AI for cardiac auscultation. Diagnostic performance declined alongside AI reliability, even when physicians were cognitively forced to make an initial classification, and when human performance exceeded AI reliability. Physicians’ confidence declined faster than their trust in AI. Results call for specification of oversight goals and processes ensuring patient safety.
zh_abstract: 越来越多的医生必须监督AI系统以检测系统故障。我们在一项随机对照研究中研究了48名医生，使用一个故障日益增多的AI进行心脏听诊。诊断性能随AI可靠性下降而下降，即使医生在认知上被强制要求做出初步分类，并且即使人类表现超过AI可靠性时也是如此。医生的信心下降得比他们对AI的信任更快。结果要求明确监督目标和流程，以确保患者安全。

title: Beyond skin deep: physiologic oral pigmentation as an overlooked validation gap in AI-assisted oral cancer screening
zh_title: 口腔癌AI筛查中色素沉着的验证缺口
summary: 评论指出口腔癌AI筛查工具（如MeMoSA）几乎仅在亚洲人群验证，提出生理性口腔色素沉着可能导致误分类，呼吁按色素分层验证。
key_points: MeMoSA等工具几乎仅亚洲人群验证
生理性色素沉着按种族而异且非病理
呼吁部署前开展色素分层验证
reason: 同行评审观点文章，提出公平性验证缺口，但无新数据，按综述观点档上限取5
abstract: AI-assisted oral cancer screening tools, exemplified by MeMoSA, have been validated almost exclusively in Asian populations. We propose a testable hypothesis: physiologic oral pigmentation, which varies by race independent of pathology, may cause classifiers to misclassify normal variation as suspicious or miss camouflaged lesions. Following precedent from pulse oximetry and dermatology AI, we call for pigmentation-stratified validation before deployment in racially diverse settings such as the United States.
zh_abstract: 以MeMoSA为代表的人工智能辅助口腔癌筛查工具几乎仅在亚洲人群中得到验证。我们提出一个可检验的假设：生理性口腔色素沉着会因种族而异，且与病理无关，可能导致分类器将正常变异误判为可疑，或漏诊被色素沉着掩盖的病变。参照脉搏血氧仪和皮肤病学人工智能领域的先例，我们呼吁在种族多样化环境（如美国）部署前，开展按色素沉着分层的验证。

title: [Comment] Mortality prediction using cardiac magnetic resonance: artificial intelligence versus clinicians–Quo vadis?
zh_title: 述评：心脏磁共振死亡率预测，AI与临床医生孰优
summary: Lancet Digital Health述评，围绕用心脏磁共振做死亡率预测时AI与临床医生的比较展开讨论。
key_points: 主题为CMR死亡率预测的AI与医生对比
指出CMR成本高、操作者短缺等限制
属述评，仅读摘要与描述
reason: 同行评审述评，议题有价值但非原创研究，按述评档上限内取5分
abstract: With a rise in the incidence of cardiovascular disease in ageing populations worldwide, physicians will face a substantial increase in demand for feasible and accurate diagnostics. Cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) is a highly accurate, non-ionising imaging technique for quantitative assessment of cardiac function and geometry and for detection of cardiovascular diseases. However, CMR lacks the high throughput, low cost, and portability of echocardiography. Another widespread clinical obstacle to CMR is the shortage of qualified and trained operators.
zh_abstract: 随着全球人口老龄化中心血管疾病发病率上升，医生将面临对可行且准确诊断工具需求的大幅增加。心脏磁共振（cardiac magnetic resonance, CMR）是一种高度准确、无电离辐射的成像技术，用于定量评估心脏功能和几何结构以及检测心血管疾病。然而，CMR缺乏超声心动图的高通量、低成本和便携性。CMR另一个广泛的临床障碍是合格且受过培训的操作人员短缺。

title: Large Language Model-Assisted Discharge Instructions for Diabetic Kidney Disease: Comparative Evaluation Study.
zh_title: 大模型辅助生成糖尿病肾病出院指导的对比评估
summary: 纳入101例住院DKD患者，比较低年资住院医师独立撰写与借助DeepSeek-V3.2生成出院指导的质量差异。
key_points: 101例糖尿病肾病患者出院指导
住院医师组 vs DeepSeek-V3.2辅助组对比
按CKD分期分析获益是否不同
reason: 同行评审的对比评估，样本仅101例、单中心、无临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: [JMIR medical informatics] Discharge instructions are an important component of the transition from hospital to home for patients with diabetic kidney disease (DKD), whose care often involves multiple comorbidities, medications, and stage-specific management needs. However, producing complete, accurate, clear, and personalized instructions can be challenging for junior physicians. This study aimed to evaluate whether large language model (LLM) assistance improves the quality of DKD discharge instructions produced by junior physicians and whether its benefits vary according to chronic kidney disease (CKD) stage. The study included 101 hospitalized patients with DKD. Discharge instructions for each patient were initially drafted by a group of junior residents (resident group); subsequently, another group of residents at the same level, with the assistance of DeepSeek-V3.2 (AI-assisted group), generated a separate set of discharge instructions for the same 101 patients, resulting in a total of 202 documents. Four clinical experts, including 2 nephrologists and 2 endocrinologists, independently scored both versions of the discharge instructions using a 5-point Likert scale across 5 dimensions: completeness, accuracy, safety, clarity, and personalization. Interrater reliability was assessed using the intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC). Interrater reliability was excellent in both the resident group (ICC=0.817, 95% CI 0.763-0.864; P .05). The proportion of cases achieving a ≥1-point improvement in overall quality was 99% (100/101; 95% CI 94.6%-100.0%). LLM assistance improved the completeness, clarity, and personalization of DKD discharge instructions generated by junior physicians, with advantages greatest in complex cases. A human-AI collaborative model is a promising approach to reduce documentation burden.
zh_abstract: [JMIR medical informatics] 出院指导是糖尿病肾脏病（DKD）患者从医院过渡到家庭的重要环节，这类患者的照护通常涉及多种合并症、多种药物以及针对疾病分期的管理需求。然而，对于低年资医生而言，生成完整、准确、清晰且个体化的出院指导可能具有挑战性。本研究旨在评估大语言模型（LLM）辅助是否能提高低年资医生生成的DKD出院指导质量，以及其获益是否因慢性肾脏病（CKD）分期而异。研究纳入101例住院DKD患者。每例患者的出院指导最初由一组低年资住院医师起草（住院医师组）；随后，另一组同等水平的住院医师在DeepSeek-V3.2辅助下（AI辅助组）为同一101例患者生成另一套出院指导，共产生202份文档。4名临床专家（包括2名肾内科医生和2名内分泌科医生）独立使用5点Likert量表对两版出院指导的5个维度进行评分：完整性、准确性、安全性、清晰性和个体化。评分者间信度采用组内相关系数（ICC）评估。两组评分者间信度均极佳（住院医师组ICC=0.817，95% CI 0.763-0.864；P .05）。总体质量改善达到≥1分的病例比例为99%（100/101；95% CI 94.6%-100.0%）。LLM辅助改善了低年资医生生成的DKD出院指导的完整性、清晰性和个体化程度，且在复杂病例中优势最大。人机协作模式是减轻文书负担的一种有前景的方法。

title: Evaluating Pretrained Language Semantics for Structured EHR Prediction Tasks
zh_title: 预训练语言语义用于结构化EHR预测
summary: 预印本提出tEHR，用自然语言描述EHR事件并以Mistral-7B做继续预训练与LoRA微调，在MIMIC-IV与CPRD多任务验证。
key_points: 以文本描述EHR事件替代数据集特异编码
EHR适配继续预训练加LoRA任务微调
MIMIC-IV四任务与CPRD胰腺癌预测外部评测
reason: 有跨数据集外部评测与新方法，但为未经同行评审预印本
abstract: Structured Electronic Health Records (EHR) models typically treat each clinical concept as a dataset-specific token, discarding the natural-language semantics associated with the event. As a result, relationships between concepts must largely be learned from EHR co-occurrence, without directly exploiting any prior semantic knowledge. We investigate how pretrained causal language models can be adapted for longitudinal EHR prediction by developing tEHR. Here, we represent events with their natural language description and use this text stream to apply EHR-adaptive continued pretraining, followed by task-specific discriminative fine-tuning using LoRA, utilising the LLM as a longitudinal patient-encoder. We evaluate this approach across four prediction tasks on the MIMIC-IV dataset and pancreatic cancer prediction on the CPRD dataset at 1 to 12 month horizons, with tEHR using the Mistral-7B-v0.3 backbone achieving the strongest overall performance. Ablations show that performance declines when clinical descriptions are removed or misaligned, when numerical values are omitted, and when either stage of adaptation is removed, while explicit elapsed-time descriptions provide little additional benefit. Analysis of the learned patient representations further reveals clinically coherent structure associated with distinct patterns of disease risk and clinical history.
zh_abstract: 结构化电子健康记录（EHR）模型通常将每个临床概念视为数据集特定的标记（token），丢弃与该事件相关的自然语言语义。因此，概念之间的关系在很大程度上必须从EHR共现中学习，而未直接利用任何先验语义知识。我们通过开发tEHR，研究如何将预训练的因果语言模型适配用于纵向EHR预测。在此，我们用事件的自然语言描述来表示事件，并使用该文本流进行EHR自适应持续预训练，随后使用LoRA进行任务特定的判别式微调，将LLM用作纵向患者编码器。我们在MIMIC-IV数据集上的四项预测任务以及CPRD数据集上的胰腺癌预测（1至12个月预测时程）中评估该方法，其中采用Mistral-7B-v0.3骨干的tEHR取得最强的总体性能。消融实验显示，当临床描述被移除或错位、当数值被省略，以及当任一适配阶段被移除时，性能均下降；而明确经过时间的描述几乎没有额外获益。对学习到的患者表示的分析进一步揭示了与不同疾病风险和临床病史模式相关的临床一致结构。

title: [Editorial] Coasting on artificial intelligence safety
zh_title: 社论：AI智能体安全事件与治理缺口
summary: 《柳叶刀·数字健康》社论列举过去一年公开报道的AI智能体入侵技术平台、统计门户及篡改个人数据的系统安全事件，呼吁重视AI智能体安全。
key_points: 公开报道含AI智能体入侵医疗相关系统
有人担忧生存性威胁，有人视为营销炒作
社论称AI智能体正快速演化，或超出人类管控
reason: 社论观点类，无数据与研究设计，属常规观点文章档
abstract: Colluding on unsanctioned message boards and infiltrating a technology platform. Hacking the statistics portal of a health care scheme. Accessing and modifying personal data and business invoices. These are just a few examples from the past year of publicly reported systems breaches by artificial intelligence (AI) agents. Such reports have heightened some people's concerns that AI poses an existential threat, with others dismissing such concerns as marketing hype. What is not debatable is that AI agents are rapidly evolving, potentially beyond human containment.
zh_abstract: 在未经批准的信息板上串通勾结并渗透技术平台。入侵某医疗保健计划的统计门户网站。访问并修改个人数据和商业发票。这些只是过去一年公开报道的人工智能（AI）智能体系统入侵事件的少数例子。此类报道加剧了一些人的担忧，即AI构成生存性威胁，而另一些人则将这些担忧斥为营销炒作。无可争议的是，AI智能体正在快速演进，可能超出人类的控制范围。

title: Curiosity-0826-4B: Generative Medical Event Sequence Modeling Across Pediatric and Adult Populations
zh_title: 生成式医疗事件序列基础模型Curiosity-0826-4B
summary: 基于 Epic Cosmos 训练的生成式医疗事件基础模型更新版，可零样本预测临床事件并扩展至儿科人群。
key_points: 实验室值预测MAE较前版降低18–46%
儿童哮喘新诊断AUROC 0.742–0.785
镰状细胞危象AUROC 0.820–0.847，低于成人0.915
reason: 大规模EHR基础模型有基线对比与儿科扩展，但为预印本、评估有限
abstract: We introduce Curiosity-0826-4B, an updated version of the generative medical event foundation model trained on Epic Cosmos that simulates patient timelines to produce zero-shot clinical predictions. Curiosity-0826-4B incorporates a broader patient population and richer clinical event representations, while generally matching or exceeding Curiosity-0226-1B, the largest model in the previous Curiosity-0226 series, on evaluated tasks supported by both models. Laboratory value prediction improved, with MAE 18--46% lower than that of Curiosity-0226-1B. We evaluated prediction of disease events across pediatric cohorts aged 2--17 years. AUROCs for new asthma diagnosis (0.742--0.785) and asthma exacerbation (0.829--0.852) were comparable to those in the adult reference cohort, while AUROCs for sickle cell crisis (0.820--0.847) were lower than in adults (0.915). Explicit representation of documented death enabled new mortality prediction tasks among adults across hospice, inpatient, and ambulatory settings (AUROC 0.821--0.942). Scaling-law analysis guided compute-optimal initial pretraining followed by continued pretraining with context extension. The resulting Curiosity-0826-4B model has more parameters (4.3B versus 1B) and a longer context window (16K versus 8K). It processes 56% fewer training tokens and requires 2.2 times the training floating point operations (FLOPs) compared with its predecessor. By extending a common zero-shot prediction strategy to pediatric patients and additional outcomes, Curiosity-0826-4B broadens opportunities to develop clinical and operational applications without training separate task-specific models. Further validation should assess local calibration, performance across patient subgroups and event frequencies, timeline completion rates, and generalization to new settings, alongside prospective evaluation of clinical and operational utility.
zh_abstract: 我们介绍了Curiosity-0826-4B，这是在Epic Cosmos上训练的生成式医疗事件基础模型的更新版本，其模拟患者时间线以生成零样本临床预测。Curiosity-0826-4B纳入了更广泛的患者人群和更丰富的临床事件表示，同时在两个模型均支持的受评估任务上，总体达到或超过Curiosity-0226-1B——上一代Curiosity-0226系列中最大的模型。实验室数值预测得到改善，MAE较Curiosity-0226-1B低18–46%。我们在2–17岁的儿科队列中评估了疾病事件的预测。新发哮喘诊断（0.742–0.785）和哮喘加重（0.829–0.852）的AUROC与成人参考队列相当，而镰状细胞危象的AUROC（0.820–0.847）低于成人（0.915）。对已记录死亡的显式表示使得能够在临终关怀、住院和门诊环境中的成人中开展新的死亡预测任务（AUROC 0.821–0.942）。缩放定律分析指导了计算最优的初始预训练，随后进行带有上下文扩展的持续预训练。所得的Curiosity-0826-4B模型具有更多参数（4.3B对1B）和更长的上下文窗口（16K对8K）。与其前代模型相比，它处理的训练token少56%，所需训练浮点运算次数（FLOPs）为2.2倍。通过将一种常见的零样本预测策略扩展到儿科患者和更多结局，Curiosity-0826-4B拓宽了在不训练单独任务特定模型的情况下开发临床和运营应用的机会。进一步验证应评估本地校准、跨患者亚组和事件频率的性能、时间线完成率以及对新环境的泛化能力，同时开展对临床和运营效用的前瞻性评估。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Pulmonary Hypertension: Advancements, Opportunities, and Challenges.
zh_title: 肺动脉高压中的人工智能：进展、机遇与挑战
summary: 综述梳理人工智能在肺动脉高压筛查、诊断、分型、风险分层与预后预测中的应用与挑战。
key_points: 涵盖心电、影像与电子病历等多模态数据
应用覆盖筛查、分型、风险分层与预后
为综述性总结，未提供原始研究数据
reason: 有信息量的领域综述，按规则综述最高6分，无新数据
abstract: [Journal of clinical medicine] Pulmonary hypertension (PH) is a progressive cardiopulmonary disorder associated with high morbidity and mortality. Delayed diagnosis, heterogeneous disease phenotypes, and variable treatment responses remain major clinical challenges. Artificial intelligence (AI), including machine learning and deep learning, has emerged as a promising tool for improving PH management. AI-based models have demonstrated promising performance in screening, diagnosis, classification, risk stratification, and prognosis prediction using multimodal data such as electrocardiography, chest radiography, computed tomography, cardiac magnetic resonance imaging, echocardiography, and electronic health records. Furthermore, AI may support individualized risk assessment, treatment-response prediction, early identification of right ventricular deterioration, and longitudinal remote monitoring. Emerging technologies, including explainable AI, federated learning, large language models, and digital twins, may further advance precision medicine in PH. Despite these advances, data quality, interpretability, privacy, and clinical implementation of AI remain challenges. This review summarizes current applications, opportunities, and challenges of AI in PH and discusses future directions for AI-assisted precision healthcare.
zh_abstract: [Journal of clinical medicine] 肺动脉高压（pulmonary hypertension，PH）是一种进行性心肺疾病，与高发病率和死亡率相关。诊断延迟、疾病表型异质性和治疗反应差异仍是主要临床挑战。人工智能（artificial intelligence，AI），包括机器学习和深度学习，已成为改善PH管理的有前景工具。基于AI的模型在利用心电图、胸部X线摄影、计算机断层扫描、心脏磁共振成像、超声心动图和电子健康记录等多模态数据进行筛查、诊断、分类、风险分层和预后预测方面已表现出有希望的性能。此外，AI可能支持个体化风险评估、治疗反应预测、右心室恶化的早期识别和纵向远程监测。包括可解释AI、联邦学习、大语言模型和数字孪生在内的新兴技术，可能进一步推进PH的精准医学。尽管有这些进展，数据质量、可解释性、隐私和AI的临床实施仍然是挑战。本综述总结了AI在PH中的当前应用、机遇和挑战，并讨论了AI辅助精准医疗的未来方向。

title: Do Rule-Derived Labels Improve Prediction When Reported Labels Are Limited? A Two-Site Machine Learning Study
zh_title: 规则弱标签能否提升有限标注下的预测
summary: 预印本在两家医疗系统的大肠埃希菌尿培养数据上做标签预算实验，评估规则衍生弱标签对耐药预测的价值。
key_points: 两站点EHR数据、多个报告标签预算比例
任务为头孢类药敏非敏感预测
比较仅报告标签与加入规则弱标签
reason: 双站点方法学研究、设计规范，但为预印本且属探索性实验
abstract: **Background.** Rule derived (weak) labels can enlarge a training set when reported labels are scarce. Their value depends on label quality, on how the extra records shift the training distribution, and on whether the comparison accounts for reported labels set aside for tuning or calibration. **Methods.** We ran an exploratory label-budget experiment on *Escherichia coli* urine cultures from two de-identified electronic health record datasets: Stanford ARMD and UT Southwestern ARMD-UTSW. The task was to predict reported non-susceptibility to cefepime, cefoxitin and ceftazidime (Stanford) and to cefepime and ceftazidime (UT Southwestern). Reported-label budgets of 10%, 25%, 50% and 100% of development patients were drawn over five patient-disjoint outer splits. Logistic regression and histogram gradient boosting were trained with reported labels only, or with added rule-derived labels using equal weights, a tuning-selected weight, class-proportion adjustment or prior-probability correction. These were compared with an all-budget reported-only baseline that used every budgeted reported label for training. Stanford used the inferred labels released with the dataset and a feature set including resistance history. UT Southwestern used researcher-derived labels from Stanford rule text, which were not validated for that site, and an age-only primary model. Brier-score differences were assessed with paired patient-cluster bootstrap intervals. **Results.** All rule-derived labels were susceptible. Equal-weight augmentation lowered mean predicted risk well below observed prevalence (for example, Stanford cefepime at the 10% budget: 0.35% versus 4.85%) and had a higher Brier score than the all-budget baseline in every drug, model and budget summary. The tuning-selected weight did not consistently improve on the all-budget baseline. Its median Brier difference was positive in 38 of 40 drug, model and budget summaries. Its paired intervals lay above zero in 100 of 296 Stanford analyses and 31 of 198 UT Southwestern analyses, and below zero in 3 and 5. The tuning set often selected a weight of zero (146 of 296 and 153 of 198 analyses). At UT Southwestern, the age-only models showed little discrimination (median AUROC 0.49 to 0.54), so those comparisons mainly reflect calibration. **Conclusions.** Under these designs, rule-derived labels did not consistently improve probability prediction over a reported-only model that used the whole reported-label budget for training.
zh_abstract: 【背景】当已报告标签稀缺时，规则衍生（弱）标签可以扩大训练集。其价值取决于标签质量、额外记录如何改变训练分布，以及比较是否考虑了留作调参或校准的已报告标签。【方法】我们在两个去标识化电子健康记录数据集——Stanford ARMD 和 UT Southwestern ARMD-UTSW——的大肠埃希菌（Escherichia coli）尿培养上开展了一项探索性标签预算实验。任务是预测对头孢吡肟、头孢西丁和头孢他啶（Stanford）以及对头孢吡肟和头孢他啶（UT Southwestern）的已报告非敏感性。在五个患者不重叠的外部分割上，抽取占开发集患者10%、25%、50%和100%的已报告标签预算。逻辑回归和直方图梯度提升分别仅使用已报告标签训练，或加入规则衍生标签并以等权重、调参选定的权重、类别比例调整或先验概率校正进行训练。这些模型与全预算仅报告标签基线（使用全部预算内已报告标签进行训练）进行比较。Stanford使用数据集随附发布的推断标签以及包含耐药史的特征集。UT Southwestern使用研究者根据Stanford规则文本衍生的标签（未在该中心验证）以及仅年龄的主模型。Brier评分差异采用配对患者聚类bootstrap区间评估。【结果】所有规则衍生标签均为敏感。等权重扩增使平均预测风险远低于观察到的患病率（例如Stanford头孢吡肟在10%预算时：0.35% 对 4.85%），并且在每种药物、模型和预算汇总中，其Brier评分均高于全预算基线。调参选定的权重并未持续优于全预算基线。在40项药物、模型和预算汇总中，有38项的中位Brier差异为正。其配对区间在296项Stanford分析中有100项位于零以上，在198项UT Southwestern分析中有31项位于零以上，分别有3项和5项位于零以下。调参集经常选择权重为零（296项分析中有146项，198项分析中有153项）。在UT Southwestern，仅年龄模型区分度很低（中位AUROC 0.49至0.54），因此这些比较主要反映校准。【结论】在这些设计下，与使用全部已报告标签预算进行训练的仅报告标签模型相比，规则衍生标签并未持续改善概率预测。

title: Enrollees and Early Lessons from an Agentic Healthcare Platform with Physicians in the Loop
zh_title: 医师监督的智能体医疗平台：入组者特征与早期经验
summary: 描述3223名医师监督智能体平台的入组者特征，并与全国调查基准比较疾病负担与就医碎片化。
key_points: 中位年龄51岁，62%为男性
各年龄段慢病患病率高于全国调查4–7个百分点
功能性疾病用户触发更多医生升级与人工处理
reason: 智能体平台使用者画像有信息量，但为描述性预印本、无结局评估
abstract: Agentic healthcare platforms that combine large language models with physician oversight are growing quickly, but little is known about who uses them. We characterized 3,223 enrollees of Lotus AI, a free, physician-supervised agentic platform, who completed onboarding, messaged the agent, and had a linked health record between February and July 2026, and compared them with national benchmarks. Median age was 51 years and 62% were male. Chronic condition prevalence exceeded 2024 National Health Interview Survey estimates in every age band by 4 to 7 percentage points; 18% had a functional or symptom-defined disorder; among the 30% with four or more ambulatory visits in the prior year, care was spread across nearly five providers, with 44% meeting a threshold for high fragmentation. Users with functional disorders generated 1.8 times as many physician escalations and 2.6 times as many laboratory orders as other users, but no more prescriptions. This profile differs from the younger, predominantly female populations reported for direct-to-consumer telemedicine. It moves chronic disease management, functional disorder pathways, and care coordination from aspirations to design requirements, and we argue that deployed AI care platforms should characterize their populations against national benchmarks early.
zh_abstract: 将大语言模型与医生监督相结合的代理式医疗平台正在快速增长，但对其使用者知之甚少。我们对Lotus AI的3,223名入组者进行了特征描述，并与国家基准进行比较；Lotus AI是一个免费的、由医生监督的代理式平台，这些入组者在2026年2月至7月期间完成了入组引导、向代理发送过消息并拥有关联健康记录。中位年龄为51岁，62%为男性。每个年龄段的慢性病患病率均比2024年国家健康访谈调查（National Health Interview Survey）估计值高4至7个百分点；18%患有功能性或症状定义的障碍；在既往一年有四次或以上门诊就诊的30%人群中，照护分散在近五名提供者之间，44%达到高度碎片化阈值。患有功能性障碍的用户产生的医生升级次数是其他用户的1.8倍，实验室检查医嘱是2.6倍，但处方并不更多。这一特征与直接面向消费者的远程医疗所报告的更年轻、以女性为主的人群不同。这将慢性病管理、功能性障碍诊疗路径和照护协调从愿景转变为设计要求，我们认为，已部署的AI照护平台应尽早依据国家基准描述其人群特征。

title: AToP: An Explainability Framework for Transformer-Based EHR Predictions Using Attribution-Guided Temporal Pattern Mining
zh_title: AToP：基于归因引导时序模式挖掘的EHR可解释框架
summary: 在MIMIC-IV v3.1（218,196例）训练的Transformer再入院模型上，将逐token积分梯度转为结构化时序模式解释。
key_points: AUROC 0.77、PR-AUC 0.34
掩蔽、逆序与token忠实性检验验证
与KernelSHAP对比归因效果
reason: 预印本新方法，大样本但仅内部验证、预测性能一般，属值得一看档
abstract: Objective: To develop and evaluate AToP (Attribution to Temporal Patterns), a post-hoc explainability framework that converts per-token Integrated Gradients (IG) from a Transformer into structured temporal pattern narratives. Materials and Methods: AToP was applied to a single-stream Transformer trained on MIMIC-IV v3.1 (218,196 patients; 12.6% unplanned 30-day readmission). It mines frequent episodes from salient-token subsequences in the training cohort, aggregates attribution among patients whose records contain each token or pattern, and collapses near-duplicates by patient overlap. Validation used masking, reversed-order analysis, token-level faithfulness tests, and KernelSHAP comparison. Results: The Transformer achieved AUROC 0.77 and PR-AUC 0.34. Population-weighted attribution emphasized high-prevalence codes with small per-patient impact. Carrier-conditional attribution, the mean among patients with the token, surfaced rare high-attribution psychiatric markers including psychosis, self-harm overdose, suicidal ideation (SI), and severe major depressive disorder (MDD). Pattern-level attribution identified within-visit co-occurrences and cross-visit trajectories not captured by token rankings. Risk-increasing patterns included psychiatric sequences ({MDD, SI} [->] SI) and oncologic progressions (cancer anemia [->] ascites). Obstetric and chest pain evaluation patterns were associated with lower predicted readmission. Discussion: The framework provides two complementary views of model predictions: carrier-conditional aggregation highlights rare, highly attributed clinical features, while temporal pattern analysis identifies within-visit combinations and cross-visit trajectories missed by token-level rankings. Masking and visit-order reversal provided evidence of correspondence with model behavior, but pattern attributions do not represent unique effects or establish clinical validity. Conclusion: AToP turns a Transformer's attributions into visit-anchored temporal pattern narratives, showing which events, in which order, contribute to its readmission predictions.
zh_abstract: 【目的】开发并评估 AToP（Attribution to Temporal Patterns），一个事后可解释性框架，可将 Transformer 中逐 token 的积分梯度（Integrated Gradients, IG）转换为结构化的时间模式叙述。【材料与方法】AToP 应用于一个在 MIMIC-IV v3.1（218,196 名患者；12.6% 非计划 30 天再入院）上训练的单流 Transformer。它从训练队列中显著 token 的子序列中挖掘频繁事件片段，在记录中包含每个 token 或模式的病人中汇总归因，并按患者重叠度合并近重复项。验证采用掩蔽、逆序分析、token 级忠实性检验以及与 KernelSHAP 的比较。【结果】该 Transformer 达到 AUROC 0.77 和 PR-AUC 0.34。人群加权归因强调了高患病率编码，但其对每位患者的影响较小。携带者条件归因，即在具有该 token 的患者中的均值，显现出罕见的高归因精神科标志物，包括精神病性障碍、自伤性过量、自杀意念（suicidal ideation, SI）和重度抑郁症（major depressive disorder, MDD）。模式级归因识别出 token 排名未捕捉到的就诊内共现和跨就诊轨迹。风险增加模式包括精神科序列（{MDD, SI} [->] SI）和肿瘤进展（癌症贫血 [->] 腹水）。产科和胸痛评估模式与较低的预测再入院风险相关。【讨论】该框架提供了模型预测的两种互补视角：携带者条件聚合突出罕见、高归因的临床特征，而时间模式分析识别出 token 级排名遗漏的就诊内组合和跨就诊轨迹。掩蔽和就诊顺序反转提供了与模型行为相对应的证据，但模式归因并不代表独特效应，也未确立临床有效性。【结论】AToP 将 Transformer 的归因转化为以就诊为锚点的时间模式叙述，展示哪些事件以何种顺序对其再入院预测有所贡献。

title: Constructing and Validating Memorisation Audits for EHR Foundation Models
zh_title: EHR基础模型记忆化审计框架的构建与验证
summary: 在MIMIC-IV训练的GPT-2式EHR模型上，用重建、敏感属性披露和患者级canary检验评估记忆化程度。
key_points: 固定窗口重建与敏感属性披露测试
随机患者级canary仅轻微提升标签恢复
训练集与留出集披露差异较小
reason: 预印本，方法清晰含阳性对照，为隐私审计提供证据但无外部数据集验证
abstract: Autoregressive electronic health record (EHR) foundation models may disclose training information at inference, yet clinical predictability makes patient-specific memorisation difficult to distinguish from generalisation. We evaluate fixed-window token reconstruction, sensitive-attribute disclosure, and random patient-level canaries in GPT-2-style models trained on MIMIC-IV, across early, best-validation, and final checkpoints. Reconstruction improves with additional context, but training--held-out differences remain small. Trajectory-unique prompts containing limited clinical information produce no excess sensitive disclosure for training patients. In a matched model with random binary patient-level canaries, training-patient label-recovery AUROC increases from 0.512 to 0.549 while held-out recovery remains at chance. An overfit 1,000-patient positive control achieves near-perfect recovery, confirming sensitivity to strong memorisation. These results reveal weak cohort-level memorisation but no reliable patient-level disclosure under the evaluated attacks. They motivate clinically grounded inference-time audits that can detect patient-specific memorisation in existing models without retraining with canaries.
zh_abstract: 自回归电子健康记录（EHR）基础模型可能在推理时泄露训练信息，但临床可预测性使患者特异性记忆难以与泛化区分。我们在基于MIMIC-IV训练的GPT-2风格模型中，评估固定窗口token重建、敏感属性泄露和随机患者级金丝雀，涵盖早期、最佳验证和最终检查点。重建随上下文增加而改善，但训练集与留出集之间的差异仍然很小。包含有限临床信息的轨迹独有提示未对训练患者产生额外的敏感信息泄露。在带有随机二元患者级金丝雀的匹配模型中，训练患者的标签恢复AUROC从0.512升至0.549，而留出集恢复仍处于随机水平。一个过拟合的1,000例患者阳性对照实现了近乎完美的恢复，确认了对强记忆的敏感性。这些结果揭示了弱队列级记忆，但在所评估的攻击下没有可靠的患者级泄露。它们支持开展有临床依据的推理时审计，从而无需用金丝雀重新训练即可检测现有模型中的患者特异性记忆。

title: Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Care After Hospital Discharge for People With Decompensated Cirrhosis
zh_title: 失代偿期肝硬化出院后AI辅助管理随机试验
summary: 新注册的多中心随机试验，计划纳入180例，评估在常规照护上增加AI辅助主动管理能否减少90天内非计划住院。
key_points: 三中心、180例、随机分组
主要终点为90天非计划住院
尚未开始招募，无结果
reason: 前瞻随机设计为加分项，但仅注册无结果、干预描述简略，属增量档
abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Beijing Tsinghua Chang Gung Hospital; conditions: Decompensated Liver Cirrhosis; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 180; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] This study will compare two ways of supporting adults with cirrhosis after they leave hospital. Cirrhosis is severe scarring of the liver. Eligible participants will have been hospitalized for liver-related complications and will be ready for discharge. The main question is whether adding an artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted management service to usual care reduces unplanned hospital care caused by worsening liver disease during the next 90 days. The study plans to enroll 180 adults at three centers. Participants will be assigned by chance, with an equal chance of receiving usual care alone or usual care plus AI-assisted proactive management. Participants receiving the additional service, or their authorized caregivers, will complete a brief daily health report taking about 3-5 minutes and may report symptoms when they occur. The system helps organize reports and identify information requiring attention. Nurses check the information, and physicians make clinical decisions. The system does not independently diagnose illness, prescribe treatment, or change medication. Both groups will continue their usual medical care and have study follow-up contacts on days 7, 30, 60, and 90. The study will compare unplanned emergency visits, hospital observation, acute same-day treatment, and readmissions related to worsening liver disease. Safety and the burden of using and delivering the service will also be assessed. Participants with urgent symptoms should seek emergency care without waiting for a response from the study platform.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：北京清华长庚医院；疾病：失代偿性肝硬化；类型：INTERVENTIONAL；分期：NA；入组人数：180；状态：NOT_YET_RECRUITING] 本研究将比较两种在肝硬化成人患者出院后为其提供支持的方式。肝硬化是严重的肝脏瘢痕化。符合条件的参与者将因肝脏相关并发症住院，并已达到出院条件。主要问题是：在常规照护基础上增加人工智能（AI）辅助管理服务，是否能减少未来90天内因肝病恶化导致的非计划住院照护。研究计划在三个中心入组180名成人。参与者将被随机分配，接受单纯常规照护或常规照护加AI辅助主动管理的几率相等。接受额外服务的参与者或其授权照护者将完成一份简短的每日健康报告，耗时约3-5分钟，并可在症状出现时报告症状。系统帮助整理报告并识别需要关注的信息。护士核查信息，医生做出临床决策。系统不独立诊断疾病、不开具治疗处方，也不更改用药。两组均继续其常规医疗照护，并在第7、30、60和90天进行研究随访联系。研究将比较与肝病恶化相关的非计划急诊就诊、医院观察、急性当日治疗和再入院情况。还将评估安全性以及使用和提供该服务的负担。出现紧急症状的参与者应寻求急诊照护，不应等待研究平台的回复。

title: Artificial intelligence-driven precision management of Helicobacter pylori: an integrated framework from endoscopy and multi-omics to vaccine design and digital care.
source: PubMed · Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology
zh_title: AI驱动的幽门螺杆菌精准管理框架
summary: 综述提出整合内镜与多组学AI、疫苗设计与数字照护的五模块概念框架，覆盖幽门螺杆菌诊疗全流程。
key_points: 提出五模块AI全流程管理概念框架
涵盖CNN到视觉语言基础模型的内镜应用
强调耐药 burden 与传统诊断准确性不足
reason: 概念性综述框架，无新数据或验证，属增量档
abstract: [Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology] Helicobacter pylori (H. pylori) infection, affecting half of the world's population, is the principal cause of peptic ulcer disease and gastric cancer, yet its clinical management is increasingly undermined by the rapidly escalating global burden of antibiotic resistance, the suboptimal accuracy of conventional diagnostic methods, and the declining efficacy of empirical therapeutic regimens. Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly reshaping this landscape, but existing research remains fragmented across single modalities. We propose a conceptual five-module framework that integrates AI approaches across the H. pylori care continuum: (1) global disease burden and the evolutionary dynamics of H. pylori drug resistance; (2) the application of multimodal AI, from convolutional neural networks to vision-language foundation models, for endoscopic early screening, pathological identification, and functional assessment; (3) the harnessing of machine learning (ML) on genomic and electronic health record data to decipher resistance mechanisms and generate personalized eradication regimens; (4) AI-driven vaccine target discovery and generative design, spanning reverse vaccinology to de novo immunogen creation; and (5) a digital closed-loop patient management platform that leverages new media and reinforcement learning to enhance adherence and eradication rates. We further delineate the core challenges of data bias, cross-scenario generalization, and the critical absence of prospective randomized evidence, and propose a future direction anchored in multimodal foundation models, federated learning, and continuous AI quality improvement. Rather than an established clinical pathway, this framework is proposed as a conceptual blueprint that, once prospectively validated, could upgrade AI-enabled H. pylori care from isolated image recognition toward an end-to-end "perception-reasoning-intervention" system, offering a blueprint for precision prevention and control.
zh_abstract: 【Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology】幽门螺杆菌（Helicobacter pylori，H. pylori）感染影响全球一半人口，是消化性溃疡病和胃癌的主要原因，然而其临床管理日益受到以下因素的削弱：快速上升的全球抗生素耐药负担、传统诊断方法准确性欠佳，以及经验性治疗方案疗效下降。人工智能（AI）正在迅速重塑这一格局，但现有研究仍分散于单一模态。我们提出一个概念性的五模块框架，将AI方法整合到H. pylori全程照护中：（1）全球疾病负担与H. pylori耐药性的演化动态；（2）多模态AI的应用，从卷积神经网络到视觉-语言基础模型，用于内镜早期筛查、病理识别和功能评估；（3）利用机器学习（ML）处理基因组和电子健康记录数据，以解析耐药机制并生成个体化根除方案；（4）AI驱动的疫苗靶点发现和生成式设计，涵盖反向疫苗学到从头创建免疫原；（5）一个数字闭环患者管理平台，利用新媒体和强化学习提高依从性和根除率。我们进一步阐明数据偏倚、跨场景泛化和前瞻性随机证据严重缺乏等核心挑战，并提出以多模态基础模型、联邦学习和持续AI质量改进为锚点的未来方向。该框架并非已确立的临床路径，而是作为一个概念性蓝图提出；一旦经过前瞻性验证，它可将AI赋能的H. pylori照护从孤立的图像识别升级为端到端的“感知-推理-干预”系统，为精准预防和控制提供蓝图。
